purpose: Show invalid-policy error output and the default reject sandwich result through the real module CLI.
output:
CASE invalid-policy
COMMAND python3 -m mev_shield
INPUT_ID demo-bad-policy
INPUT_POLICY hold
INPUT_HASHES a-buy,b-victim,c-sell,d-gap,e-buy,f-victim,g-sell
EXIT 2
STDOUT {"id":"demo-bad-policy","status":"error","code":"BAD_POLICY","order":[],"hits":[],"rollback":[],"kept":[],"dropped":[]}
STDERR BAD_POLICY
RESULT_KEYS id,status,code,order,hits,rollback,kept,dropped
CASE default-reject
COMMAND python3 -m mev_shield
INPUT_ID demo-reject
INPUT_POLICY <default>
INPUT_HASHES a-buy,b-victim,c-sell,d-gap,e-buy,f-victim,g-sell
EXIT 0
STDOUT {"id":"demo-reject","status":"rejected","code":"SANDWICH_DETECTED","order":[],"hits":[{"buy":"a-buy","victim":"b-victim","sell":"c-sell","token":"TOKEN","at":[0,1,2]},{"buy":"e-buy","victim":"f-victim","sell":"g-sell","token":"TOKEN","at":[4,5,6]}],"rollback":[],"kept":[],"dropped":[]}
STDERR 
RESULT_KEYS id,status,code,order,hits,rollback,kept,dropped

purpose: Show quarantine hits, rollback reasons, surviving order, and a real post-quarantine no-hit check.
output:
CASE quarantine
COMMAND python3 -m mev_shield
INPUT_ID demo-quarantine
INPUT_POLICY quarantine
INPUT_HASHES a-buy,b-victim,c-sell,d-revert,e-buy,f-victim,g-sell,h-dependent,i-keeper
EXIT 0
STDOUT {"id":"demo-quarantine","status":"mitigated","code":"SANDWICH_MITIGATED","order":["i-keeper","f-victim","b-victim"],"hits":[{"buy":"a-buy","victim":"b-victim","sell":"c-sell","token":"TOKEN","at":[0,1,2]},{"buy":"e-buy","victim":"f-victim","sell":"g-sell","token":"TOKEN","at":[4,5,6]}],"rollback":[{"hash":"a-buy","at":0,"reason":"SANDWICH_DETECTED"},{"hash":"c-sell","at":2,"reason":"SANDWICH_DETECTED"},{"hash":"d-revert","at":3,"reason":"REVERT"},{"hash":"e-buy","at":4,"reason":"SANDWICH_DETECTED"},{"hash":"g-sell","at":6,"reason":"SANDWICH_DETECTED"},{"hash":"h-dependent","at":7,"reason":"DEPENDENT_NONCE"}],"kept":["i-keeper","f-victim","b-victim"],"dropped":["a-buy","c-sell","d-revert","e-buy","g-sell","h-dependent"]}
STDERR 
RESULT_KEYS id,status,code,order,hits,rollback,kept,dropped
CASE post-quarantine-order
COMMAND python3 -m mev_shield
INPUT_ID demo-order-clean
INPUT_POLICY reject
INPUT_HASHES i-keeper,f-victim,b-victim
EXIT 0
STDOUT {"id":"demo-order-clean","status":"ok","code":"","order":["i-keeper","f-victim","b-victim"],"hits":[],"rollback":[],"kept":["i-keeper","f-victim","b-victim"],"dropped":[]}
STDERR 
RESULT_KEYS id,status,code,order,hits,rollback,kept,dropped
